== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Ki-Adi-Mundi (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text (the PC website card list). '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-42-Ki_Adi_Mundi.png]]) and the Master List (2013) show the words of [[Ki-Adi-Mundi (V)]] and the current text.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); 11 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words, and its straight quote marks, are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “While Maul present, Ki-Adi-Mundi (V){{!}}Ki-Adi-Mundi is Heroic. Obi-wan's Cape, Obi-wan's Journal, and [Virtual Block 5] Jedi Lightsaber (V) (Virtual Block 5){{!}}Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Ki-Adi-Mundi. Once per game, may exchange two cards from hand with any one card in Lost Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch C2/C3 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
